text: 深圳市房地产中介协会发布最新数据显示，8月份，深圳新建商品房成交3467套，环比下降23.0%，同比增长4.8%；深圳二手住宅录得5108套，环比下降2.3%，同比增长7.6%。今年1-8月，深圳二手房累计录得约4.84万套，同比增长4.7%。
text_en: According to the latest data from the Shenzhen Real Estate Intermediary Association, new commercial housing transactions in Shenzhen totaled 3,467 units in August, down 23.0% month-on-month but up 4.8% year-on-year. Second-hand residential properties recorded 5,108 transactions, down 2.3% month-on-month and up 7.6% year-on-year. From January to August, cumulative second-hand housing transactions in Shenzhen reached approximately 48,400 units, up 4.7% year-on-year.
